countdown.arrived_sub: We can't wait to celebrate with you

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.sub: What we have planned for you

dress.title: Dress Code
dress.note: Wear any colour you love — the one gentle request is to leave white for the bride. August in Neuchâtel ran warm last year, so lean breezy and comfortable.

story.title: Our Story
story.body: We met in England — one of us Colombian, the other Swiss, both convinced we were only passing through. What was meant to be a chapter survived long distance, countless airports, and more voice notes than either of us can count. Now we're home together in Neuchâtel, and we can't imagine saying our 'yes' without you there beside us.

stay.title: Your Stay
stay.note: Breakfast included. The booking is on us — just show your ID at reception.

accommodation.title: Accommodation
accommodation.sub: A few places we love nearby

faq.title: Questions
faq.a_children: We adore your little ones, but our celebration is adults-only so everyone can relax and dance freely. Thank you for understanding.
faq.q_transit: What is the best way to get there?
faq.a_transit: Neuchâtel is well connected by train. From the station it is a short taxi or shuttle ride — we will run shuttles from the main hotels before and after the ceremony.
faq.a_parking: Yes, free parking is available at the venue. If you plan to enjoy the wine, please leave the car and hop on a shuttle.
faq.q_diet: What if I have dietary restrictions?
faq.a_diet: Just let us know in your RSVP. Our kitchen happily accommodates vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and allergy needs.
faq.q_checkin: When can I check into the hotel?
faq.a_checkin: From 15:00 on the afternoon of the ceremony. You can drop bags earlier at reception if you arrive before then.
faq.q_brunch_time: What time is brunch the next day?
faq.a_brunch_time: 10:00 at the hotel. Come as you are — no dress code, just appetite.
